mode: Native utf8mb4 and empty SQL mode. Use mandatory materialization on MySQL 5.6 and independently check derived_merge=on on later releases.
scope: An independently defined chain of one through sixteen native position-only projections with a physical signed INT and stock utf8mb4_bin VARCHAR leaf layout.
structure: Every outer result stores an exact ordinal and a name, and its parent holds the independently checked definition. Its native kind and collation are determined by the leaf position reached through every intermediate ordinal. There is one movable definition with no volatile or external effects.
conditions: Each listed ordinal addresses its immediate definition, each projection owns a nonempty checked ordered list, and the depth limit is sixteen. The leaf uses one absolute ordinary physical source and may filter or apply DISTINCT. A derived construction and an analyzed local source use the same boundary.
meaning: Evaluate the leaf once, including NULL, filtering, and DISTINCT under the native source collations. For each selected row, consume each intermediate ordinal in order. A DISTINCT PAD SPACE tie permits the exact stored bytes of one whole input row. Conserve the row multiplicity after performing each pure local projection.
sql: Assign generated column names by ordinal at each local boundary. Write the registered final result labels by position and preserve the exact physical reference. Ordinary single-use independent WITH and derived table inputs use the same checked local structure.
externalInterpretation: Resolve two named tables with the same layout and different cardinalities. Verify the length, field types and stock collation identities independently using the disposable server before executing any case.
observations: Native binary-protocol column type, collation identifier and result label by position, including empty results
Exact typed row bag, case, spaces, NUL, NULL, duplicate aliases and duplicate output ordinals
Leaf filter and DISTINCT with available PAD SPACE tie representatives before the outer projections
Exact local name shadow, occurrence identity, and deep composition to the sixteen-boundary endpoint

finite.completeness: Independently require the full product of physical source, depth, leaf quantifier and final ordinal layout from the actual value graph. Match every intermediate reversal in each finite case.
